criteria.text: The new session's persisted messages equal the parent's messages up to and including the fork message (DB assert on copied rows; parts_json intact).

criteria.text: SDK fork failure → AppError; no local row is left behind (rollback assert).

criteria.text: Prompting the fork routes input to the fork's sdk id, not the parent's (vitest via map).
